productionAnswers: He goes to school as usual.
I expect my friend to come today.

I stay in a small hotel.  
The room is clean and nice.  
I like the bed and the shower.
We have stock of pencils in the shop.

I like to go to the park.  
Can we meet at 3 p.m.?  
Yes, I am free tomorrow.
I take apart my toy car to clean it.
I get carried away when I play games.

I pay for the book.  
I give money to the shopkeeper.  
I get my receipt and leave.
